standard: Lease audit log of the DHCP service on the domain controllers and of the employee VPN address pool; column names are plain
notes: All times UTC with a Z suffix. Complete for the user networks. Workstations and laptops have reserved addresses: the address of a machine is always its address in gw_host_registry.json. Desktops renew every four days while they run and ask again each time they start; laptops ask when they are docked at the start of the owner's working day. A machine that is switched off logs nothing. The employee VPN pool (scope corp-vpn, 10.14.250.0/24) hands an address to each remote session: one ASSIGN and one RELEASE for every connection to the VPN concentrator in the Zeek conn log (VPN sessions are recorded in full). A VPN device is a company laptop (hostname in the registry) or a home computer; a home computer's name (DESKTOP-..., LAPTOP-...) and MAC address are not in the registry but do not change from session to session.

leases.description: One row per lease event, in time order.

fields.name: event
fields.notes: ASSIGN, RENEW, RELEASE, EXPIRE, NACK (a request for an address of another network, refused)

fields.name: hostname
fields.notes: hostname in gw_host_registry.json; on scope corp-vpn it may be the name of a home computer (DESKTOP-..., LAPTOP-...) that is not in the registry

fields.name: lease_s
fields.notes: Lease length granted, 0 for RELEASE, EXPIRE and NACK
